title: Battleship Texas
summary: The Houston-based rogue operations site and final major location of Compromised.

claims.text: Compromised identifies Battleship Texas in the Houston area as the rogue cell's operations center and the source of its local network signal.
The novel places Eclipse Virus payloads aboard the vessel during the Gulf Coast operation.

paragraphs.text: Battleship Texas is not presented as a passive landmark in the novel. It is the operating hub of the rogue cell and the location of its stored viral payloads.

verification.notes: The entry records only the novel's fictional use of Battleship Texas, not real-world vessel history.
